rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of P0 (already fixed by main agent BEFORE this iteration): the sync `_is_valid_admin_token` was retired in TRACK 15.32 and now always returns False. Five factory-built gates (make_require_safety_or_admin, make_require_safety_or_admin_fleet, make_require_safety_admin_or_pm, make_require_shop_or_admin_fleet, make_require_dispatch_or_admin) were still binding the retired sync validator, silently rejecting every admin token issued by /api/auth/multi-login. Fix: new is_valid_admin_token_async kwarg on each factory, wired at server.py callsites to _is_valid_directory_admin_token_async. Reproduction (regression-locked): GET /api/meetings with X-Admin-Token from multi-login pre-fix returned 401 'Safety, Admin, or PM login required'; post-fix returns 200 with list body. Live verified against the preview backend.
